fitted_on: 2019-01 to 2026-08: 70 observed months of the 2019 to 2023 backcast (outside the pandemic) joined to July 2024 to August 2026, all overnight-risk connections, realized over expected claims
rule: multiplier of month m = exp(grand mean + shrunk deviation of the month's mean log ratio), with the deviation shrunk by n/(n + kappa)
